tw: Kron and his accomplice, a calm police pup, swipe a comb and a plum pie.
twc: Kron 和帮凶——一只淡定的警犬——偷了梳子和李子派。
hint: 帮凶竟是警犬。

tw: Kron makes an accusation: a cuckoo sat on my station cake!
twc: Kron 提出控诉：一只布谷鸟坐在我车站买的蛋糕上！
hint: 蛋糕扁了，嫌疑鸟在装傻。

tw: A crab and a crow fight with acrimony over Kron's money while Kron cries.
twc: 螃蟹和乌鸦为 Kron 的钱吵得刻薄又凶，Kron 在哭。
hint: 它们吵得凶，钱是他的。

tw: Kron's tent adjoins a goat's tent, so the goat joins him, coins and noise and all.
twc: Kron 的帐篷挨着山羊的帐篷，山羊带着硬币和吵闹钻了进来。
hint: 隔壁太近，邻居住进来了。

tw: Kron administers a minute mint to a sleepy minister, who sits up mid-sentence.
twc: Kron 给打瞌睡的部长喂颗小薄荷，部长立刻坐直。
hint: 一颗薄荷，管住整场会议。

tw: Kron admonishes a monkey for licking his dish, then praises it for polishing it.
twc: Kron 训斥猴子舔他的盘子，又夸它把盘子舔得锃亮。
hint: 先骂后夸，盘子是真亮。

tw: A flea flicks onto Kron and afflicts him, so he flicks and flicks all night.
twc: 一只跳蚤弹到 Kron 身上折磨他，他弹了一整夜。
hint: 一只跳蚤，折磨一整夜。

tw: Kron does alchemy and yells 'Al, come see my gold!' but Al sees cheese.
twc: Kron 炼完金喊：“阿尔快来看金子！”阿尔只看到奶酪。
hint: 炼出来的金子，是奶酪。

tw: Kron cleans the mammoth's pen with ammonia, and the mammoth moans, 'Oh no, ya!'
twc: Kron 用氨水打扫猛犸象的圈，猛犸象哀嚎：“哦不要啊！”
hint: 氨水一开，猛犸都扛不住。

tw: Kron strolls down the old arcade with a car cake as cards cascade behind him.
twc: Kron 拿着汽车蛋糕走过古老拱廊，身后纸牌哗啦啦倒成一片。
hint: 走过拱廊，身后纸牌全塌。

tw: Kron's archaeology team digs up a car key, a dolly and a jolly jelly.
twc: Kron 的考古队挖出车钥匙、洋娃娃和一块开心果冻。
hint: 千年古迹，挖出一块果冻。

tw: Kron mocks an archaic car, and the archaic car kicks his cake into a lake.
twc: Kron 嘲笑一辆老爷车，老爷车一脚把他的蛋糕踢进湖里。
hint: 笑老爷车土，被老爷车整了。

tw: Aristocrat Kron rests his wrist on a toast crate and sips tea with a rat.
twc: 贵族 Kron 把手腕搭在吐司箱上，和一只老鼠喝茶。
hint: 贵族范儿，吐司箱当扶手。

tw: Kron's ascent up the cliff stops at a scent: someone sent him a cinnamon bun.
twc: Kron 爬悬崖爬到一半闻到香味：有人给他送来了肉桂卷。
hint: 上升途中，被香味拐跑了。

tw: Ascetic Kron sits on a set of sticks, eats one sesame stick, and calls it a feast.
twc: 苦行的 Kron 坐在一堆木棍上，吃一根芝麻棒，说这是大餐。
hint: 一根芝麻棒，他吃成满汉全席。

tw: Seagulls assail Kron's sailboat, so Kron sails away in a pail.
twc: 海鸥围攻 Kron 的帆船，Kron 坐在水桶里漂走了。
hint: 船被攻陷，水桶照样航行。

tw: A sassy assassin sneaks into Kron's garden and gets sassed into weeding it.
twc: 嚣张的刺客溜进 Kron 的花园，被怼得只好拔草。
hint: 刺客来了，被派去拔草。

tw: A sassy cat sneaked in to assassinate Kron's cake and ate eight bites.
twc: 一只嚣张的猫溜进来要“干掉”Kron 的蛋糕，咬了八口。
hint: 刺杀目标：蛋糕。

tw: Assiduous Kron sat till six and did sixty sums, then saw it was Sunday.
twc: 勤勉的 Kron 坐到六点做完六十道题，才发现是星期天。
hint: 刻苦一整夜，今天放假。

tw: Kron audits the owl's books, asks 'Who did it?', and every owl hoots 'Ow, I did!'
twc: Kron 查猫头鹰的账：“谁干的？”全体猫头鹰：“我！”
hint: 一查账，全员认罪。
